install.linux: sudo apt install gh || sudo dnf install gh

env_vars.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env_vars.description: GitHub personal access token (or use `gh auth login`)

list_issues.guidance: Add --state=open or --state=closed to filter. Use --limit N for pagination.

create_issue.guidance: Body can be multiline. Use --label to add labels.

create_pull_request.guidance: head = source branch, base = target branch

merge_pull_request.guidance: Defaults to squash merge. Pass --rebase or --merge for other strategies.

get_file_contents.guidance: owner_repo format: owner/repo. Path relative to repo root.

notes: The gh CLI must be authenticated: run `gh auth login` first. Most commands operate on the current repo by default. Specify --repo owner/repo to target a different repository.
